explanation: This fires only at the GO step, when the agent chooses a1 right after a trial that reached S2 and got no reward: usually 9-10 after an a1-to-S2 rare loss, and about 4-6 after an a2-to-S2 common loss. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at GO when choosing a2, and at GO after a rewarded trial or after a loss in S1.
